acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

constructor.details: Ships deprecated and without a token deployer. Deploy order (D38):        factory, then `new ArtCoinsDeployerV2(factory)`, then        `setTokenDeployer`, then the remaining wiring, then `setDeprecated(false)`.

deployToken(((address,string,string,byte.details: Uses `defaultProtocolFeeBps`. `msg.value` must be at least      `deployFee + sum(extension msgValue)`; any excess is refunded to the sender.

deployTokenAsOwner(((address,string,stri.details: Owner only (FT-03). `protocolBps` in [0, MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS]; 0 appends no protocol slot.

deploymentInfo(address).details: Reverts `NotFound` for a token this factory did not launch.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

setHook(address,bool).details: Enabling checks `constantsHash()` and that the hook's PoolManager is ours.      Disabling never calls the target (FT-04).

setMevModule(address,bool).details: Enabling requires `supportsInterface(type(IArtCoinsMevSkimV2).interfaceId)`      (refuses v1 lp fee modules, D22) and a matching `constantsHash()`.

setMinProtocolSkimShareBps(uint16).details: <= BPS. Launch bountyBps is capped at min(MAX_BOUNTY_BPS, BPS - this),      and the referral cap must fit above this floor (D52).

setProtocolRecipient(address).details: Injected into new pools only: the skim protocol leg and the locker protocol slot.

setTeamFeeRecipient(address).details: Receives the deploy fee. 0 is allowed only while `deployFee == 0`      (a launch with a fee and no recipient reverts `TeamFeeRecipientNotSet`).

setTokenDeployer(address).details: The deployer must have code, answer `factory() == this` and a         matching `constantsHash()`. Never 0: launches would revert anyway,         use `setDeprecated` to stop public launches.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

configHash(((address,string,string,bytes.notice: keccak256(abi.encode(c)). Folded into the deploy salt with the sender.

constantsHash().notice: `Constants.hash()` of the build this contract was compiled with.

deployToken(((address,string,string,byte.notice: Public launch. `msg.value` = deployFee + sum of extension msgValue.

deployTokenAsOwner(((address,string,stri.notice: Owner only launch; the only path that overrides the protocol slot bps.

exemptAllowed(address).notice: D47: contracts a launch may list in `TaxConfigV2.exempt`, on top         of the implicit set (this launch's locker and hook, enabled         escrows, enabled extensions). Never a contract with a public         sweep (v4 PositionManager, universal router): that would make the         tax optional for everyone.

minLpFee().notice: D53: launch lp fee floor in 1e6 units, owner set within [0, MAX_LP_FEE].

poolManager().notice: The Uniswap v4 PoolManager every enabled hook must answer.

renounceOwnership().notice: Disabled: an ownerless factory would freeze allowlists and rescue (FT-13).

rescue(address,address,uint256).notice: Sends stray eth (`token == address(0)`) or erc20 held by the factory.

setExemptAllowed(address,bool).notice: D47: adds or removes a tax exempt candidate. Affects new launches only.

setMinLpFee(uint24).notice: D53: launch lp fee floor. Affects new launches only.

setTokenDeployer(address).notice: D38: points the factory at a token deployer bound to it.

tokenDeployer().notice: CREATE2 token deployer (D38): its own contract, bound to this         factory at its construction, wired with `setTokenDeployer`.         Replacing it changes every future token address (the deployer is         the CREATE2 origin), so `predictToken` answers for the current one.
